research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Xero Limited is focused on enhancing financial software systems, emphasizing secure data exchange, risk categorization, and efficient transaction processing. They are developing methods for secure account transfers and automated data reconciliation, including graphical user interfaces for improved user experience. Their R&D includes generating labeled datasets for financial documents, predicting cash flow, and detecting compromised accounts. They also work on methods for database performance testing and facilitating asynchronous communication. Xero's innovations aim to streamline accounting practices, ensure data security, and optimize financial management.

product.description: Payroll functionality within Xero for calculating and managing employee pay, with plan-based employee limits and localized payroll support.
